Academic English Language Program

Download as PDF

The Academic English Language program is designed for students whose native language is not English, and who want to study at the college to earn a certificate or degree. The focus is on reading, writing, listening, speaking and American culture, with emphasis on group interaction and active learning. Class sizes are small, with courses offered during the day and evening in every term.
